answer: The beacon counter is kept in vertex and willow shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2518 identities would post 2017 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
